source.label: Bob's Guide to Classic Pinball Machines

strategy.summary: Make three top saucers to hold bonus. Complete A-B-C-D once to light the 10x lanes. Then build the held pin bonus to 39,000 without completing a fourth set.

steps.text: Plunge the top saucer. From the right flipper, repeat the left orbit until the saucer has collected three times on this ball.
modeNotes: Hold Bonus: The third top-saucer collect stores the complete pin bonus for the next ball.
A saucer scores 500 unlit or 5,000 after A-B-C-D is complete.

steps.text: Complete A-B-C-D once. Use natural bumper hits for A and B and safe defensive shots for C and D.
modeNotes: Green-star 10x values: One A-B-C-D completion raises the three left-orbit buttons and both inlanes from 100 to 1,000. It raises the top saucer from 500 to 5,000.
A-B-C-D target progress carries between balls. The lit 10x values end at the drain.

steps.text: Let upper feeds and safe shots roll over the ten center pin buttons. Complete three full pin sets for 30,000 bonus.
modeNotes: Pin bonus: Each unlit pin is worth 1,000. Each completed ten-pin set lights one 10,000 Strike.

steps.text: After three complete sets, collect up to nine pins in the fourth set for a 39,000 maximum. Do not collect the tenth pin; it resets the loose-pin portion to zero.
With Hold Bonus and a large pin bonus secured, repeat the lit left orbit and 5,000 saucer.

fallback.title: Hold Bonus first
fallback.when: Use this when the A-B-C-D rebounds or side lanes are dangerous.

steps.text: Repeat the left orbit and collect three top saucers.
Let natural upper-playfield returns roll over unlit center pin buttons to raise pin bonus.
Carry the bonus to the next ball before attempting the remaining letters.

alternatives.title: Extra ball or Special
alternatives.when: Use this only when the event awards useful points or allows the extra ball.

steps.text: Complete A-B-C-D twice on one ball for extra ball.
Make five top saucers to light the left outlane for Special.
Do not take these risks after a held 39,000 bonus already secures the needed score.
Make three top saucers to light Hold Bonus.
Complete three full pin sets and nine pins of the fourth.
Drain without tilting. Start the next ball with the held 39,000.

techniques.name: Shatz pass
techniques.instruction: With strong flippers, shoot up a wide inlane and continue into the C or D target. Use it only after the target rebound proves safe.

cautions.issue: The side outlanes are very large, and old side-wall rubber can be too dead to return the ball.
cautions.response: Nudge before the ball reaches the dead wall. Do not expect a passive wall bounce to find the inlane.

cautions.issue: A ball that misses the top saucer can fall through the center or into bumper trouble.
cautions.response: Test the orbit-to-saucer feed. Stop forcing Hold Bonus when missed entries do not return safely.

cautions.issue: Direct A-B-C-D rebounds can drain or feed a bumper.
cautions.response: Let upper bumper action collect A and B. Shoot C or D only when one hit completes the set or a tested shatz reaches it safely.

strategy.simpleOverview: In Triple Strike, collect the top saucer three times on one ball to hold pin bonus for the next ball. Complete A-B-C-D once to raise the left-orbit buttons, inlanes, and saucer to 10x value, then complete three ten-pin sets plus nine pins of the fourth for a held 39,000 bonus.
strategy.overview: In Triple Strike, three top-saucer collects hold pin bonus for the next ball, while one A-B-C-D completion raises the left-orbit buttons, inlanes, and saucer to 10x value until the drain. Secure Hold Bonus first, complete three ten-pin sets plus nine pins of the fourth, then repeat the lit left orbit and 5,000 saucer without collecting the final pin that would reset the loose-pin value.
